concerns.text: SC-001 states "The percentage of videos retained after filtering is measured against the hypothesized target of [deferred] discard rate." The placeholder `[deferred]` provides no concrete target, making the success criterion unmeasurable.
SC-005 mentions "The total training time ... is measured against a predefined time limit" but never defines what that time limit is, so the criterion cannot be evaluated.

FR-003 requires discarding the bottom [deferred] of videos based on the physics consistency score. The placeholder `[deferred]` leaves the discard proportion undefined, rendering the requirement unverifiable.
FR-006 specifies a power requirement (≥ 0.80 at effect size d = 0.5) but does not state the required sample size or how it will be computed, so the test cannot be confirmed as satisfied.

SC-002 says the physical consistency score will be measured against the PhysisForcing baseline but does not define the exact metric or threshold for comparison, leaving the success condition ambiguous.
